WITH player_assist_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    a / CAST(g AS FLOAT) AS assist_ratio
  FROM fielding_postseason
  WHERE a IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND g > 0
),
player_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    AVG(assist_ratio) AS player_avg
  FROM player_assist_ratios
  GROUP BY player_id
),
overall_average_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(player_avg) AS overall_avg
  FROM player_averages
  WHERE player_avg IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.player_avg,
    oa.overall_avg
  FROM player_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_average_calc oa
  WHERE pa.player_avg IS NOT NULL 
    AND oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
    AND pa.player_avg > oa.overall_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(player_avg) AS avg_of_player_averages,
  AVG(player_avg - overall_avg) AS avg_difference
FROM filtered_pairs
